CallFailed(address,string,bytes).notice: This event is emitted when a call to an address fails in a protocol function (like finalize()).

CommitRevealMissed(address,uint256,uint2.notice: Emitted when a participant submitted commit in the previous round but did not submit reveal in the current round.

ConfigUpdateAddress(string,address,addre.notice: Emitted after updating config parameter of type address

ConfigUpdateBool(string,bool,bool,uint25.notice: Emitted after updating config parameter of type boolean

ConfigUpdateInt(string,int256,int256,uin.notice: Emitted after updating config parameter of type int

ConfigUpdateUint(string,uint256,uint256,.notice: Emitted after updating config parameter of type uint

InvalidVote(string,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Emitted when an invalid report is submitted

NewRound(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when a new voting round is started.

NewSymbols(string[],uint256).notice: Emitted when the oracle symbol list is updated

NewVoter(address,uint8).notice: Emitted when a new reporter submits a report

NoRevealPenalty(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when a participant gets penalized for missing too many reveals in a certain window

Penalized(address,uint256,string,int256,.notice: Emitted when a participant gets penalized as an outlier

PriceUpdated(uint256,uint256,string,bool.notice: Emitted when a new price is calculated for a symbol

SuccessfulVote(address,uint8).notice: Emitted when a valid report is accepted

TotalOracleRewards(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when oracle rewards are distributed

distributeRewards(uint256).notice: Distributes oracle rewards to voters based on their performance. Called by Autonity at finalize().

finalize().notice: Finalizes the current round and aggregates the votes. Called by the Autonity contract.

getDecimals().notice: Decimal places to be used with price reports

getNewVotePeriod().notice: Retrieve the new vote period that is going to be applied at the end of the vote round.

getNewVoters().notice: Retrieve the list of new participants in the Oracle process.

getNonRevealThreshold().notice: Returns the tolerance for missed reveal count before the voter gets punished.

getRewardPeriodPerformance(address).notice: Retrieve the performance for a voter in this reward (epoch) period.

getRoundData(uint256,string).notice: Return price data for a specific round.

getSymbols().notice: Retrieve the lists of symbols to be voted on.

getVoters().notice: Retrieve the list of participants in the Oracle process.

setCommitRevealConfig(uint256,uint256).notice: Setter for commit-reveal penalty mechanism configuration.

setSlashingConfig(int256,int256,uint256,.notice: Setter for the internal slashing and outlier detection configuration.

setSymbols(string[]).notice: Update the symbols to be requested. Only effective at the next round. Restricted to the operator account.

setVotePeriod(uint256).notice: Setter for the vote period, new vote period will be applied at the end of the round.

setVoters(address[],address[],address[]).notice: Called to update the list of the oracle voters.

updateVotersAndSymbol().notice: updates voters and symbols, taking into account boundary edge cases.         Called by Autonity at the start of a new Oracle round

vote(uint256,(uint120,uint8)[],uint256,u.notice: Allows a validator to vote for the current period using a commit-reveal scheme. This function implements a commit-reveal voting mechanism for validators in the consensus committee. Validators can only vote once per round, and their votes will be discarded if they leave the consensus committee or not counted if they try to vote again in the same round. If a validator attempts to vote multiple times in a round, the transaction will revert. Important: Non-reverting calls are refunded by the Autonity Protocol.

notice: This contract implements the Oracle for the Autonity Protocol, allowing voters to submit price reports and aggregate them while detecting outliers.
